messages:
elaine: Heads-up — we need to kick off a base image rebuild for runtime 2.1 to address CVE-2025-1184 and trim down setuid bits across layers. low blast radius but want a clean plan.
rajiv: ack. two quick Qs: signing key flow during cutover? and do we want new RBAC rules for the build runners?
elaine: plan sketch: 1) build minimal image in staging with layered SBOM 2) sign with ephemeral cosign key (keystore-backed) 3) promote to canary, run verification hooks, then full cutover 4) rotate old cosign keys after stable
thomas: prefer a signing proxy so we don't add long-lived IAM perms to node pools. signer runs as a pod with keystore access.
rajiv: +1 on proxy. RBAC: grant signer service account only the crypto signer role in the keystore namespace. CI runners keep upload-only perms.
elaine: also need audit logs for signing/verify actions. Cloud logging should capture cosign:Sign and cosign:Verify events — ensure retention and alert on Verify failure.
sec-ci-bot: NOTICE: pipeline failed for runtime-base:v2.1-staging — missing cosign.annotations.provenance
maria: triaging the vuln: libssl in one of the distro layers. exploitability low in our config but we should rebuild with patched package. can bump openssl in the buildpack.
elaine: good. add 'strip setuid' step and smaller shell + remove package manager caches. aim for deterministic build and reproducible layers.
thomas: incident scenario: if verification fails during canary, rollback to pinned image tag and disable rollout. Need a quick revoke plan for ephemeral key.
rajiv: revoke flow: 1) revoke key via KMS 2) mark image as untrusted in registry metadata 3) trigger rollback pipeline. document TTL for ephemeral keys (e.g., 2h).
elaine: checklist snippet to include in runbook: preflight scans, RBAC terraform diff, build & sign, verify hooks, deploy canary, monitoring/alerts, rollback steps.
maria: who is oncall for the window? ops-team + sec-rotation?
rajiv: ops-team oncall + sec-rotation + eng-runtime as secondary.
thomas: add automated audit grep after deploy, example command: 
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=k8s_container AND protoPayload.methodName="cosign.Verify"' --limit 50
```
elaine: RBAC terraform example (on PR): 
```
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "signer" {
  metadata { name = "image-signer" namespace = "signing" }
}
resource "google_project_iam_member" "signer_kms" {
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"
  member = "serviceAccount:${kubernetes_service_account.signer.metadata[0].name}@${var_project}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}
```
rajiv: sec note: avoid granting 'roles/storage.admin' to signer; only give read access to target registry objects and signer perms to KMS.
sec-ci-bot: REMINDER: attach SBOM and provenance to every image - field: image.metadata.sbom_path
maria: timeline suggestion: Thursday 10:00 PT, 2-hour window. canary for 15m, then staged rollout.
elaine: I'll open the PR with terraform + runbook + cosign integration tests. tagging @ops @eng-runtime @security.
thomas: please include test that deliberately corrupts signature and asserts verification failure (so devs don't accidentally rely on missing checks).
rajiv: also add alert: high rate of cosign.Verify failures -> page sec-rotation.
elaine: agreed. I'll add Slack alert + PagerDuty route.
maria: ok, will watch the PR and be oncall during window. :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks everyone — creating the runbook + PR now. will post link here when ready.
